result.title: Recalibrating a Typed-Decision Model in an Afternoon: A Hands-On Recipe for Laya's Confidence Scores
result.summary: A typed-decision model such as Laya reads a text and a list of options that the caller defines, for example ticket categories, and returns a probability for each option. Code around it compares the top probability with a threshold to answer, abstain or escalate to a person. Earlier work reports, for a Turkish model, that temperature scaling can raise held-out calibration error (ECE). This tutorial gives a five-step recipe (measure, diagnose, fit, validate, deploy) in 130 lines of numpy with standard methods, none new. On 1,065 synthetic, LLM-labelled items the released Laya checkpoint has a pooled ECE of 0.073 but a bucket-macro ECE of 0.143 (0.127-0.184), the mean over buckets (questions grouped by type and option count): the 12-option bucket is over-confident by +0.22, the three-to-five-option bucket under-confident by 0.05, and they cancel. One global temperature makes pooled ECE worse (0.173); a cross-fitted temperature per bucket brings macro-ECE to 0.073 (0.078 over 10 fold assignments) and reaches 0.089 with 10 labelled items per bucket, but holding out one of seven evaluation sets gives 0.099. After the refit, a gate aimed at 10% error answers 46.3% of items (10.5% wrong) against 6.9% on the published confidences, but one cut-off per bucket on the published confidences answers 45.4%, so most of the gain comes from separating buckets. Confidence-only maps (Platt, histogram, isotonic) need 20 or more labelled items per bucket to approach the temperature; with 320 per bucket the lowest macro-ECE belongs to Platt. In these files the retrained checkpoints store no per-bucket table and the stored 12-option value 0.1006 is clamped to 0.5 at runtime; the refit helps 31 of 33 checkpoints on random folds and 21 with a set held out. Fit and test share one generator and LLM labels, so these are findings about these checkpoints and this data.

AI.brief_summary: 论文给出一份五步校准配方（测量、诊断、拟合、验证、部署），用约 130 行 numpy 在合成 LLM 标注数据上诊断 Laya 这类「文本＋候选选项」类型决策模型的置信度：汇总 ECE 为 0.073，但按「问题类型＋选项数」分桶的宏平均 ECE 达 0.143，全局温度反而使汇总 ECE 变差，分桶交叉拟合温度可将宏 ECE 降到 0.073 左右，并明显提高按 10% 错误率设门控时的作答比例。
AI.relevance_reason: 分桶校准及由阈值触发的作答／弃答／转人工，可能为 LVR 中「STOP」决策的置信度校准与停止阈值设定提供可核查线索；但该工作为纯文本分类校准、无视觉或多模态推理状态，属方法借鉴而非直接竞争。
